objectives.text: Descend into the drained basin and reach specimen transfer.

architectural_direction.all: Distinct district architecture: exposed reservoir/bridge and piping for Containment; stacked specimen machinery/gantries and rupture framing for Breach.

structural_connections.policy: Two accessible upper balconies; firing shutters open only after both feed flags and actual drain. Physical slotted parapets prevent passage; central both-feeds gate unchanged.

actor_overrides.reason: After drain: reciprocal ranged attack through actual .4m parapet slot from6.6m horizontal; blocked by shutter beforeboth.

parapet.deviation: Root approved real .4m firing slots rather than a full1.4m wall, which blocks actual standing-player enemy LOS. Actual swept .12m enemy/.09m player projectiles then clipped the initial .65m base despite thin ray clearance; lowered visible base to.4m and extended posts down, retaining total1.4m barrier and.4m clear widths. Actual contact and anti-bypass reruns required; no projectile exemptions or invisible body.

structural_connections.nearby_props: Existing overlook fittings stay inside room z>=-13; nearest basin tanks x±11,z-32 and columns x±16.4,z-28; no new climbable items beside gallery ends.
risks: Stand/crouch/diagonal and projectile diameter proofs required; .4m slots are smaller than .6m capsule, but metadata alone does not prove anti-bypass.
Basin actors are visually submerged until3.5m liquid drains; shutters must block all shots/LOS until actual drain.
Enemy navigation unchanged; these are firing balconies, never an alternate physical path into gated basin.
